sentences.text:

For the Petitioner(s)/Applicant(s) : Mr. Nilesh Kumar, Adv.

For the State : Mr. Gautam Rakesh, A.P.P.
 ----
 th
 06/Dated: 14 June, 2024
1. Since in pursuance of the order dated 14.05.2024, Mr. Anjani Anjan, S.P., Latehar is present
before this Court, his personal appearance is hereby exempted.
2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

3. The applicant who is in custody since 17.10.2022 has renewed his prayer for grant of regular bail in connection with Chhipadohar P.S. Case No.35 of 2022 corresponding to Special POCSO Case No.05 of 2023, registered for the offence under Sections 341, 342, 376 & 377 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 4 & 8 of the POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Additional Sessions Judge-II-cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Latehar.
4.

It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
5. Innocence has been claimed by the learned counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in this case due to ulterior motive.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail and it has been submitted that the prosecution evidence has already been closed.
7. Considering the stage of the evidence and the material available on record, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the present bail application stands rejected.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
